text:
The U.S. Constitution is the supreme law; under it, federal statutes and treaties outrank conflicting state law, and valid federal regulations issued under those statutes do the same. State constitutions come next, then state statutes, state regulations, and local ordinances, with judicial decisions interpreting each level rather than sitting above it. Where sources at the same level conflict, the later enactment generally controls, and lower law yields wherever it contradicts higher law.

CONFIDENCE: 90
